heroHeadline: 28 Days to Kickoff — Iran Sets Tucson Base Camp Amid US-Iran Conflict; France Squad Today; Germany, Brazil Announcements Ahead
heroSubtitle: NJ Transit slashed World Cup round-trip rail fares for MetLife Stadium (host of the July 19 Final) from $150 to $98 on May 13, with ticket sales opening the same day via the NJ Transit Mobile App; shuttle bus fares were simultaneously cut from $80 to $20, with automatic $60 refunds for prior purchasers. New York City unveiled 'Soccer Streets' — car-free zones near approximately 50 schools. Arsenal and England defender Ben White was ruled out of the 2026 World Cup with MCL damage sustained in Arsenal's 1-0 win over West Ham, ending his international return under Thomas Tuchel who names England's final 26-man squad on May 22. A major internal dispute erupted in Mexican football as coach Javier Aguirre called a domestic training camp during Liga MX Clausura quarterfinals — the federation threatened to exclude non-reporters from the World Cup squad, while Chivas president Amaury Vergara went public with objections. Hirving 'Chucky' Lozano was excluded from Mexico's 55-man provisional roster. France's Didier Deschamps announces his final 26-man squad TOMORROW (May 14, Paris) — the last of his tenure as Les Bleus head coach; Mbappé's hamstring is being managed but he is expected in the squad. Iran's squad is scheduled to depart for a Turkey training camp on May 15 with no US visas yet issued to any Iranian player or coaching staff; the FIFA-Taj Zurich meeting (May 20) remains the last formal diplomatic channel before the June 1 final squad deadline. Squad announcements continue: Japan (May 15), Brazil (May 18, Ancelotti), Germany (May 21), USMNT (May 26, NYC, FOX Sports). FIFA publishes all 48 squads simultaneously on June 2.
